name: attention
notes: NOT taught on hardware. FACTS.md says HARDWARE_PRESENT: no (no CANable attached), so these angles were authored by hand for the simulator against yam.arm's joint limits and never sent to a motor. Lifting is done with joint3, which yam.arm records as self-collision-free across its range from home; joint2 stays near zero because from a folded home it moves the tip DOWN and self-collides past ~+105 deg. Pose set is NOT collision-verified: run yam.environment.ArmSafetyChecker before the first hardware run.
